sentences.text: Respondent :- State Of U.P.Thru. Prin.Secy.Food & Civil Supplies & Ors.

Counsel for Petitioner :- Sushil Kumar,Ashok Kumar Shukla,Kamal Kumar Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,R.P.Singh Hon'ble Pankaj Kumar Jaiswal,J.
Hon'ble Alok Mathur,J.

Heard Mr. Sushil Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr. Manish Mishra,Standing Counsel for respondent Nos. 1, 2 & 5 and Mr. R.P. Singh, learned counsel for the respondent Nos. 3 & 4.
Petitioner has filed an application for grant of license, vide annexure no. 1, under the provisions of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and the regulations made thereunder but till date his application has not been decided by the authority concerned and, therefore, prayer has been made to decide the same expeditiously.
Mr. Manish Mishra, Standing Counsel for respondent Nos. 1, 2 & 5 has submitted that if the application of the petitioner is still pending then the same will be decided in the light of the order of this Court dated 12.5.2017 passed in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017.

sentences.text: 1 Considering the aforesaid, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the competent authority is directed to consider and decide the application of the petitioner for registration of license, as the case may be, in accordance with law, in the light of the order dated 12.5.2017 passed by this Court in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017, within a period of two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before him by a reasoned and speaking order.
With the aforesaid, writ petition is disposed of.
